<style>
/* Product-specific landing. Loaded only with its Elementor product template. */
.hcf-page {
  --hcf-bg: #101318; --hcf-panel: #191e26; --hcf-panel-2: #222934;
  --hcf-dark-green: #0b4435; --hcf-green: #19c58b; --hcf-lime: #a3f451;
  --hcf-ink: #f4f7f5; --hcf-muted: #a5b0ac; --hcf-line: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --hcf-width: 1240px; --hcf-gutter: clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px); --hcf-top: 0px;
  --hcf-ease: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
  direction: rtl; text-align: right; isolation: isolate; position: relative;
  background: var(--hcf-bg); color: var(--hcf-ink);
  font: 400 15px/1.9 'peyda', Tahoma, sans-serif !important;
}
.hcf-page, .hcf-page *, .hcf-page *::before, .hcf-page *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
.hcf-page :is(h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,p,ul,ol,figure) { margin: 0; }
.hcf-page :is(h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,p,a,button,input,select,textarea,label,table,.elementor-heading-title,.elementor-button) { font-family: 'peyda', Tahoma, sans-serif !important; }
.hcf-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
.hcf-page a:focus-visible, .hcf-page button:focus-visible, .hcf-page input:focus-visible, .hcf-page select:focus-visible, .hcf-page textarea:focus-visible, .hcf-page summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hcf-lime); outline-offset: 3px; }
.hcf-page [hidden] { display: none !important; }
.hcf-page.e-con, .hcf-page .e-con {
  --padding-top: 0px; --padding-right: 0px; --padding-bottom: 0px; --padding-left: 0px;
  --gap: 0px; --row-gap: 0px; --column-gap: 0px; --content-width: 100%;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-wrap: nowrap; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; gap: 0;
}
.hcf-page .elementor-widget { width: auto; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; margin: 0; }
.hcf-page .elementor-widget-container { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.hcf-page .elementor-heading-title { padding: 0; color: inherit; font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; line-height: inherit; }
.hcf-page .elementor-widget-text-editor :is(p,ul,ol):last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.hcf-page .hcf-system { display: none !important; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-wrap { width: min(var(--hcf-width), calc(100% - (var(--hcf-gutter) * 2))); max-width: var(--hcf-width); margin-inline: auto; }
.hcf-page .hcf-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.hcf-page :is(#hcf-buy, #hcf-features, #hcf-how, #hcf-gallery, #hcf-faq, #hcf-reviews, #hcf-specs, #hcf-compare, #hcf-related) { scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--hcf-top) + 24px); }

/* Opening composition: real WooCommerce media is framed by restrained orbital lines. */
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: clamp(50px, 6vw, 92px) 0 74px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 17% 46%, rgba(25,197,139,.105), transparent 36%), linear-gradient(180deg, #111a19 0%, #101318 94%); }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px,transparent 1px); background-size: 62px 62px; mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,.65), transparent 92%); pointer-events: none; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-hero-layout { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.02fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(36px, 5vw, 76px); }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-hero-copy { align-items: flex-start; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
.hcf-page .hcf-eyebrow { color: #9de8c7; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .01em; }
.hcf-page .hcf-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-eyebrow .elementor-heading-title::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 27px; height: 2px; background: var(--hcf-green); }
.hcf-page .hcf-eyebrow span { color: #667b71; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-meta { margin-top: 18px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-meta .product_meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; color: #c6dacf; font-size: 10.5px; }

.hcf-page .hcf-hero-meta a { color: #b8e7c7; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-title { margin-top: 17px; color: var(--hcf-ink); font-size: clamp(34px, 3.4vw, 52px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-title em { color: var(--hcf-lime); font-style: normal; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-subtitle { margin-top: 17px; color: #d5e6dc; font-size: clamp(17px, 1.45vw, 20px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.8; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-description { max-width: 510px; margin-top: 13px; color: var(--hcf-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 2.15; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-hero-benefits { display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; gap: 9px 20px; margin-top: 27px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-benefit { color: #c8d7ce; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.hcf-page .hcf-benefit .elementor-heading-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; white-space: normal; }
.hcf-page .hcf-benefit .elementor-heading-title::before { content: '✓'; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 17px; height: 17px; border: 1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.5); border-radius: 50%; color: #86ddb1; font: 700 10px/1 Tahoma, sans-serif; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-actions { display: flex; flex-flow: row wrap; gap: 11px; margin-top: 32px; }
body .hcf-page .hcf-button .elementor-button { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center; white-space: normal; box-shadow: none; transition: transform .25s var(--hcf-ease), background .25s var(--hcf-ease), border-color .25s var(--hcf-ease), color .25s var(--hcf-ease); }

body .hcf-page .hcf-secondary .elementor-button:is(:hover,:focus-visible) { background: #20382d; border-color: #68b890; color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-caption { margin-top: 17px; color: #9aa9a1; font-size: 11px; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-hero-visual { position: relative; justify-content: center; padding: 26px 13px; min-width: 0; }
.hcf-page .hcf-hero-visual > .elementor-widget-html:first-child { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.hcf-page .hcf-orbit { position: absolute; width: 83%; aspect-ratio: 1; left: 50%; top: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(49,199,137,.17); border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg); pointer-events: none; animation: hcf-orbit 30s linear infinite paused; }
.hcf-page .hcf-orbit-b { width: 105%; border-color: rgba(90,202,153,.08); animation-duration: 47s; animation-direction: reverse; }
.hcf-page .hcf-orbit i { position: absolute; top: 12%; left: 15%; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6fdb9d; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(83,238,141,.7); }
.hcf-page .hcf-orbit-b i { width: 4px; height: 4px; top: 70%; left: 3%; opacity: .65; }
.hcf-page.hcf-orbit-running .hcf-orbit { animation-play-state: running; }
@keyframes hcf-orbit { to { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(360deg); } }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-stage { position: relative; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(204,255,220,.15); border-radius: 13px; background: #171e22; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 0 70px rgba(27,186,119,.075); }
.hcf-page .hcf-stage-top, .hcf-page .hcf-stage-bottom, .hcf-page .hcf-screen-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 17px; color: #aebeb5; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stage-top span[dir], .hcf-page .hcf-screen-top span[dir] { margin-inline-start: auto; color: #81918a; font: 600 9px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif !important; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stage-top i, .hcf-page .hcf-screen-top i { display: block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--hcf-green); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(25,197,139,.6); }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-woo-gallery { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-width: 0; background: #f7f8f8; }
.hcf-page .hcf-images, .hcf-page .hcf-images .elementor-widget-container, .hcf-page .hcf-images .woocommerce-product-gallery { width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important; opacity: 1 !important; }

.hcf-page .hcf-stage-bottom { justify-content: space-between; min-height: 48px; color: #a5b4ab; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stage-bottom span:last-child { color: #7b8c82; font-size: 10px; }

/* Technical strip: only published requirements, attributed below. */
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); position: relative; z-index: 3; overflow: hidden; margin-top: -1px; border: 1px solid var(--hcf-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #191e23; }

.hcf-page .hcf-quick-label { color: #a5b0ac; font-size: 11px; }

.hcf-page .hcf-quick-source { grid-column: 1/-1; padding: 10px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hcf-line); color: #a5b0ac; font-size: 10.5px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-quick-source a, .hcf-page .hcf-spec-note a, .hcf-page .hcf-buy-help a, .hcf-page .hcf-tabs a { color: #89dbae; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

/* Main flow and controlled sticky purchase card. */
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(280px,320px); align-items: stretch; gap: clamp(36px, 5vw, 70px); padding-top: 70px; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-content, .hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-aside { display: block; min-width: 0; }
.hcf-page.hcf-page .hcf-buy { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--hcf-top) + 20px); overflow: hidden; padding: 25px; border: 1px solid rgba(142,202,166,.2); border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(150deg, #1b2925, #191e26 65%); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.hcf-page .hcf-buy-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #b9dfc8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; }
.hcf-page .hcf-buy-top i { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgba(143,194,158,.15); }
.hcf-page .hcf-buy-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.25); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(25,197,139,.08); color: #9de9bc; font: 18px/1 Arial,sans-serif; }
.hcf-page .hcf-buy-title { margin-top: 18px; color: #f4f7f5; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.8; }
.hcf-page .hcf-price-label { margin-top: 21px; color: #a9b8af; font-size: 11px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-price .price { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #f4f7f5 !important; font-size: clamp(24px, 2vw, 30px); font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.6; }

.hcf-page .hcf-price del { display: block; opacity: .75; color: #a5b0ac; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.hcf-page .hcf-price del .amount { color: #a5b0ac; }
.hcf-page .hcf-price .woocommerce-Price-currencySymbol { color: #b8c9bf; font-size: 12px; }
.hcf-page .hcf-snapshot { margin-top: 5px; color: #a9bbb0; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.8; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stock :is(.stock,p) { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 10px 0 0; color: #9ce5b9 !important; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stock .stock::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
.hcf-page .hcf-stock .out-of-stock { color: #ffb7ae !important; }

.hcf-page .hcf-add :is(.elementor-add-to-cart,.elementor-widget-container) { width: 100%; }
.hcf-page .hcf-add form.cart { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: stretch; margin: 0 !important; }
.hcf-page .hcf-add .quantity { flex: 0 0 68px; width: 68px; margin: 0 !important; }

body .hcf-page .hcf-add :is(button.single_add_to_cart_button,a.single_add_to_cart_button) { flex: 1 1 140px; min-height: 51px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--hcf-lime); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--hcf-lime); color: #10251a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.6; text-align: center; white-space: normal; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s var(--hcf-ease), transform .22s var(--hcf-ease); }

.hcf-page .hcf-add table.variations :is(th,td) { padding: 5px 0; color: #d8e8df; text-align: right; }
.hcf-page .hcf-add select { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid #52665a; background: #17231e; color: #fff; }

.hcf-page .hcf-add .woocommerce-variation-add-to-cart { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }

.hcf-page .hcf-notices :is(.woocommerce-message,.woocommerce-error,.woocommerce-info) { display: block !important; }

.hcf-page .hcf-content > .hcf-section:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
